cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I agreed to watch your dog today. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow's only a few hours away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. A separate word with no place in our agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An enduring feeling, not a calendar extension.

mechanism: A manages a dog handover by accepting the exact today promise while bargaining over pickup so affection cannot extend the calendar obligation.
confusable: Simple unwillingness to help lacks an accepted literal time word repeatedly used to restrict a later demand.
comparison: Box alternative narrows task meaning; dog alternative protects duration while offering a workable handoff.
seedUse: Dog-today seed supplies tomorrow pressure and affection claim; S02 should offer coordination help without extending the promise.
